decisions.question: S12 asks for a bus-api@v1 amendment: (a) a topology activated before start() is connected to its reads before start() delivers the queue, with cases that catch a runtime dropping a queued deep link (the S11 stand-in passes every current case and still drops it); (b) Bus.publish and Publisher.publish become publish<T, V extends T>(MultiWriterTopic<T> topic, V value), so publishing a String to an EventTopic<int>, or a DeepLink to nav.resolved-intent, no longer compiles. S11 asked for two wording fixes to the same contract. When does the amendment run, and is (b) a breaking amendment that stops the run?

options.label: Amend bus-api@v1 now, before flutter-binding@v1, all four changes in one step
options.consequence: flutter-binding@v1 is authored against the corrected bootstrap guarantee it depends on; the root contracts after it shift by one step; the batched wording fixes leave the post-S15 touch-up list.

options.label: Batch into the post-S15 touch-up
options.consequence: flutter-binding@v1 would bind its executor suite against a bus-api@v1 whose bootstrap guarantee is known to be too weak, and might encode the workaround S12 found (mount first, start after the first frame) as its own guarantee.

options.label: Treat (b) as breaking and stop
options.consequence: The owner decides a signature change that touches only bus-api@v1's own fixtures.

decisions.chosen: Amend bus-api@v1 now, before flutter-binding@v1, all four changes in one step
decisions.why: Change (a) is a missing guarantee that the next contract depends on, so it must land first. Change (b) is a signature change, but the stop condition is an amendment that would break an existing consumer, and none exists: no code, every contract draft, and a search of every fixture under hsdd/contract/fixture/ finds explicit type arguments to publish only in bus-api@v1's own surface and reject files, which the amendment rewrites (the other matches declare harness methods). It restores Spec §4.2 (writing a value of the wrong type to a typed topic is a compile error). One step for all four changes keeps bus-api@v1 touched once.
